Starships of the Galaxy.scope: Chapter III (Starship Modifications, pp. 38-53): movement, defense, weapon and accessory tables and prose; Starship Designer feat; Stock Ships.

Galaxy At War.scope: Vehicle and Starship Weapons (format of the SotG starship upgrades; the table prints Damage, Emplacement Points, Cost - no Availability or Size column); Vehicle Fire Effects and battlefield effects (no modification required: not components).

Threats of the Galaxy.scope: Discord missile launcher entry (installable on any vehicle or starship of Huge size or larger).

Legacy Era Campaign Guide.scope: Gravity mines table (Damage, Emplacement Points, Availability, Cost).

Clone Wars Campaign Guide.scope: Republic Vehicles, Weapon Systems (composite beam cannon, mass-driver cannon, proton grenade, rail cannon; the stat table is not in the OCR text). Other named weapons appear only in vehicle statblocks.

Rebellion Era Campaign Guide.scope: Imperial weapon systems (anti-aircraft flak pod; stat values not in the OCR text). Weapon emplacements are vehicles, not components. Three statements of unused EP for specific ships (already in the unused-EP table).

Scum and Villainy.scope: Starship Systems (additional accessories). The OCR of this chapter is corrupted: headings are legible, table cells are not. Every cell needs the PDF.

Core Rulebook.scope: Chapter 10 vehicles: vehicle weapons appear in statblocks (e.g. harpoon gun, tractor beams). No starship modification or emplacement-point system (0 occurrences of 'emplacement').

Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Gui.file: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide_djvu.txt
Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Gui.scope: Ships follow the SotG modification rules; three statblock 'Emplacement Points' lines (V-P2-01, unruled). No component table.

Galaxy of Intrigue.scope: Baffled drive, sensor decoys and miniaturized rail cannons appear only as equipment of specific ships/characters.

Scavenger's Guide to Droids.scope: Droid systems only; no starship components.

Unknown Regions.scope: Sensor baffling appears only in a ship description (SkyBlind); no component table.
